prompt: The video begins with the viewer approaching a large red torii gate at Fushimi Inari Taisha in Kyoto, Japan, under a bright sunny sky. The camera moves steadily forward, passing through the gate and onto a paved path lined with lush green trees that cast dappled shadows on the ground. As the viewer progresses, the path leads to a set of stone steps flanked by more torii gates, which they ascend smoothly. The camera continues along the path, revealing a series of smaller red torii gates forming a tunnel-like structure. The viewer navigates through this tunnel, with the camera angle slightly tilted upward, capturing the vibrant red color of the gates against the backdrop of dense foliage. The sunlight filters through the leaves, creating a play of light and shadow on the path. The scene remains empty, with no other people in sight, emphasizing the serene and tranquil atmosphere of the shrine. The camera maintains a steady pace, providing a continuous and immersive perspective of the journey through the sacred grounds.
